name: China Armor
source:
Monsters and humans were continuously engaging in the battles. The stage this time was an isolated rural village.
As there were so many dungeons occupied by monsters, there were frequent fights between monsters and people. Because of it, there were guilds whose main purposes were to hunt down the monsters.
So, a little foolish martial art beginner, Haruna, was leaving for tentacle hunting. However,…
